title: Repository-based development lifecycle
purpose: Planning only. Task descriptions authorize no implementation, production migration, deployment, purchases or engineering certification.

scope.first_release: Document-centric prototype Distribution Board (DB) designer through P3.
scope.recommended_release: Reviewed bounded DB engineering, exact CAD exports, structured AI assistance and release hardening through P7.
scope.extended_release: Conditional P8 capabilities after use-case approval and re-estimation.
non_goals: Additional panel archetypes before engineering approval

evidence.method: Read architecture and lifecycle documentation and inspect implementation paths. Source behavior takes precedence over older status prose. No application test suite, database migration, native kernel or desktop installer was executed during planning.

verified_findings.finding: PostgreSQL, managed content-addressed assets, immutable CEM/PDM revisions, version conflicts, dashboard and recovery already exist.
ProjectService.load_revision reconstructs schematic, CAD descriptors and BOM with current generators after verifying stored CEM/PDM hashes; historical output completeness is not yet guaranteed.
Save persists overlay drafts; manual transforms and schematic changes do not currently publish authoritative engineering revisions.
Change propagation reports a diff after full generation. The hardcoded dependency map is not a stage scheduler.
CAD export uses an in-process executor and restart-wide pending-artifact failure. Native FreeCAD/STEP execution is not established by generated scripts.
Duct routing rejects nonzero component rotations. Wire geometry can report PASS while required engineering subchecks are UNRESOLVED.
Requirements states, CP-SAT placement, duct routing, CEM/PDM identity contracts and frontend interaction tests are reusable foundations.
Migration head is 0004_projects; schema mapping and baseline manifest are generator-owned. Active desktop wrapper is frontend/src-tauri.

unresolved_runtime_questions: Actual passing test counts and performance
Native kernel availability, compatibility and distribution license review
Quality/completeness of manufacturer data and reviewed electrical methods
Deployment mode and acceptable engineering applicability limits
document_conflicts: Preserve AGENTS.md historical-read intent by fixing E02; do not describe current output reconstruction as a complete immutable snapshot.
Current Save/autosave semantics are contractual. Proposed working-document changes require P0-T06 approval and an explicit compatibility migration.
Older operations/status documentation may predate 0004_projects and active duct routing; verify against source before implementation.

invariants: CEM owns electrical intent and connectivity; PDM owns physical arrangement; schematic stores presentation referencing electrical identities; CAD and meshes derive from PDM.
Preserve stable component, terminal, conductor, net, route and feature IDs; use enclosure millimetres with explicit mounting-plate transforms.
Retain the modular monolith and PostgreSQL; isolate CPU/native geometry in workers without introducing distributed services unless measured need justifies them.
Manual, automatic and AI changes converge on validated, version-fenced operations. Preview cannot mutate published or working state.
Save and recovery cannot implicitly regenerate, reroute or publish. Explicit Recompute and Publish actions control these effects.
Published snapshots and shared assets are immutable. Legacy missing outputs cannot be retroactively claimed byte-identical.
Keep computation outside database transactions; publish snapshots, pins and artifact metadata atomically in a short transaction.
Preserve expected_version/lock_version and independent recovery versions; failed writes retain local edits.
Generation requires zero physical violations, including warnings. Optimization cannot trade hard constraints for score.
UNRESOLVED engineering checks are not PASS; prototype preview availability and engineering release eligibility are distinct.
Runtime HTTP reads use PostgreSQL, never implicit legacy JSON fallback.
Use additive migrations; preserve frozen baseline/seed payloads and regenerate mappings using the repository tool in an isolated authorized database.
Tombstones retain history; imports/duplication allocate and rebind identities and verify all hashes.
AI context and outputs are untrusted; allowlisted proposals require deterministic checks and explicit human acceptance.
No user database, credentials, generated native binaries or private manufacturer material enters committed fixtures.

agents.specialization: Contracts, scope, ADRs and cross-model integration
agents.authority: Prepares decisions; cannot grant human approvals.

agents.specialization: Additive Alembic migrations, PostgreSQL repositories, revisions and assets
Document lifecycle, operations, API contracts and jobs
React/Zustand workspace, SVG, React Flow and Three.js interaction
Deterministic DB algorithms and engineering traceability
agents.authority: Implements reviewed methods; qualified human approves applicability and reference values.

agents.specialization: CP-SAT constraints, enclosure geometry, duct routing and physical validation
Geometry adapters, native workers, assembly identity, STEP/GLB and drawings
Provider adapters, retrieval, structured proposals and offline evaluations
Independent regression, consistency, concurrency and end-to-end acceptance
Local session boundary, CI, worker isolation, packaging and operations
User workflows, support matrix and operational runbooks

execution_policy.task_dependencies: Only task IDs appear in dependencies. Every listed dependency must be complete with evidence; phase order alone is not a scheduling rule.
execution_policy.assignments: Agent IDs designate future specialized Codex roles, not agents launched during this planning task.
execution_policy.human_gates: A human_gate task is complete only after the named approver records an explicit decision. Codex prepares evidence and options. Silence, elapsed time and generated prose never count as approval.
definition_of_ready: Read current AGENTS.md and scoped source files
Confirm baseline has not invalidated assumptions
Required data, credentials and approvals available
Agree task-specific test fixture and expected result
definition_of_done: Focused regression checks pass; skipped checks explicitly recorded
Affected backend, frontend and API contracts remain consistent
No secrets or unintended file changes
Relevant workflow documentation updated when behavior changes
Task implementation reviewed before dependent work is accepted
execution_policy.sizing: Implementation tasks target one independently reviewable change. If discovery exceeds approximately three focused developer days, split into child task IDs and update downstream dependencies before coding; preserve the original as an acceptance gate.
execution_policy.concurrency: Parallel work is permitted on independent DAG branches. Serialize edits/migrations touching shared CEM/PDM schemas, projectStore, revision writer or OpenAPI contracts through their owning agent.
execution_policy.baseline_protection: Do not reset or alter unrelated working-tree changes. AGENTS.md was already untracked at planning start.
execution_policy.change_control: Re-read touched files when implementation begins; substitute current equivalents only with an explicit plan update. Do not silently expand supported engineering behavior.
execution_policy.evidence_record: Future execution should record task ID, commit, tests, skips, measured results and human decisions in the team's tracking system; this JSON describes planned work only.

backend_unit.limits: PostgreSQL tests may skip; report skips. Select relevant test files during individual tasks.

postgres_isolated.limits: Private configuration and account permitted to create/drop disposable panel_integration_test_<uuid> databases. Never use development data as the fixture.

frontend_build.limits: TypeScript and Vite compilation; no configured lint script.

contract.method: Pydantic/OpenAPI and TypeScript fixtures, IDs, finite units, reference integrity and schema compatibility.

browser.method: Real browser interaction suite introduced by P2-T12; exercise WebGL picking and drag, not only jsdom mocks.

native_cad.method: Pinned native worker executes export; independently reopen STEP and compare units, counts, bounds and validity against approved tolerances.

engineering_review.method: Qualified electrical reviewer signs independently calculated fixtures and applicability limits; software tests alone do not certify a panel.

security.method: Origin/session authorization, hostile inputs, resource limits and redacted structured errors.

manual_platform.method: Supported OS clean install, upgrade, Tauri sidecar and WebGL smoke checks on actual machines.

document_review.method: Verify paths, contracts, stated limitations and recorded decisions against implementation.

estimates.meaning: Inherited planning ranges, not measured Codex execution time or a sum of individually sized tasks. Recalibrate after P0 and after each phase.
estimates.token_estimates: CODEX_IMPLEMENTATION_ESTIMATE.md contains speculative token scenarios; no token or speed guarantees are implied here.

phases.title: Establish executable baseline and approve bounded contracts
phases.objective: Resolve current-state discrepancies before changing document authority.
risks: Unprovisioned isolated PostgreSQL
Missing engineering reviewer or native CAD environment

milestones.title: Baseline and independent reference cases

tasks.title: Record current workflow and contract inventory
implementation_steps: Trace create/save/recovery/generate/open/restore/export with actual request and state transitions.
Document E02 historical output reconstruction, overlay authority, all version counters and endpoints affected by later operations.
acceptance_criteria: Inventory distinguishes implemented, partial and unverified behavior with source symbols.
Every mutation path identifies version preconditions, persisted records and side effects.

tasks.title: Execute isolated baseline verification
implementation_steps: Run backend units, disposable PostgreSQL integration tests, frontend tests and build using pinned dependencies.
Record failures/skips, environment and fixture database cleanup; triage defects without silently changing expected outputs.
acceptance_criteria: Exact commands, exit codes and skip reasons are recorded.
No development database is migrated or used as test data; a failing baseline has explicit blocking defect IDs.
tasks.human_input: Provision authorized test database credentials if unavailable.

tasks.title: Create deterministic DB reference and failure fixtures
implementation_steps: Capture feasible DB and infeasible placement/routing cases with semantic CEM/PDM expectations, version pins and artifact hashes.
Measure current open/generate/render timings on declared hardware and board sizes; normalize only nondeterministic timestamps in comparisons.
acceptance_criteria: Fixtures preserve component-terminal-connection-route references and separate observed output from independently validated engineering values.
Board sizes and measurement procedure are repeatable; no unmeasured performance claim is labeled achieved.

milestones.completion_rule: Every task in this milestone satisfies its acceptance criteria with recorded verification evidence; human gates require named human approval.

milestones.title: Architecture and engineering decision gates

tasks.title: Specify document, operation and compatibility contracts
implementation_steps: Define working document, immutable revision, display state, operation envelope and schema compatibility rules with example payloads.
Define Save, explicit Recompute, Publish, Restore, dirty/stale/non-current states and legacy-overlay proposal migration; retain current Save behavior until approved.
acceptance_criteria: ADR includes IDs, origin, base sequence, preconditions, affected models, idempotency and validation status.
Legacy missing output behavior and non-destructive conversion are specified; ordinary open never silently regenerates.

tasks.title: Evaluate native geometry integration using a bounded spike
implementation_steps: Compare existing FreeCAD script path with a pinned headless FreeCAD worker and direct OCCT alternative for one enclosure, mounted part and routed wire.
Execute representative STEP export/reopen if dependencies are available; record packaging, licenses, memory/time and failure isolation. Mark unavailable execution unverified.
acceptance_criteria: Recommendation names one adapter path, exact environment and unit/identity mapping.
Native success is evidenced by reopened STEP, or an explicit unresolved prerequisite blocks later native implementation.
tasks.human_input: Provide supported OS access and approve external kernel licensing/distribution where required.

tasks.title: Approve product scope, document semantics and deployment boundary
implementation_steps: Present DB-only MVP, Save/Recompute/Publish UX, legacy migration strategy, local desktop default, supported OS, kernel recommendation and reference board limits.
Request explicit product-owner choices; recommend modular monolith, PostgreSQL, existing editors, custom typed operations and isolated geometry worker.
acceptance_criteria: Product owner records approved scope and document semantics, deployment mode, supported platforms and initial performance targets.
Selecting hosted multi-user deployment requires a separately approved identity/authorization backlog before hosted exposure; it is not covered by local-session protection.
tasks.approver: Product owner; technical lead; license owner for kernel distribution

tasks.title: Specify electrical identity and validation applicability
implementation_steps: Define conductor edges versus equipotential nets, terminal equivalence, phase/protective-earth boundaries and graphical junction semantics for DB.
Define PASS/FAIL/UNRESOLVED/NOT_APPLICABLE aggregation, required-check scopes and prototype-preview versus engineering-release labels.
acceptance_criteria: Examples cover shared busbar terminals, cross-phase rejection and graphical crossings without electrical junctions.
Missing bend/diameter/earth data cannot satisfy an applicable required check.

tasks.title: Approve bounded electrical semantics and required checks
implementation_steps: Obtain qualified engineer review of reference connectivity cases, validation applicability and constraints allowed for manual editing.
Record unsupported conditions and evidence needed for later method and catalog approval.
acceptance_criteria: Named reviewer signs net/conductor interpretation and required-check matrix.
Prototype constraints remain explicit; approval does not claim certification or approve unreviewed calculation methods.
tasks.approver: Qualified electrical engineer designated by product owner

milestones.completion_rule: Every task in this milestone satisfies its acceptance criteria with recorded verification evidence; human gates require named human approval.

milestones.title: Repeatable development baseline

tasks.title: Introduce baseline CI with disposable database coverage
implementation_steps: Add backend unit, explicitly enabled disposable PostgreSQL, frontend test and build lanes with pinned toolchains.
Publish test results and fail when an intended database lane silently skips; keep credentials in CI secrets.
acceptance_criteria: A sample PR executes all four lanes and reports skips.
CI creates and removes only its disposable databases and commits no secrets or build artifacts.

tasks.title: Accept baseline and recalibrate task scope
implementation_steps: Review unresolved baseline defects, environment availability and approved decisions.
Calibrate effort using actual pilot task time and review effort; identify owner for each shared contract.
acceptance_criteria: Every baseline failure is fixed or explicitly blocks its dependent tasks.
P1 can start with approved examples, repeatable CI and no unspecified document authority decision.

milestones.completion_rule: Every task in this milestone satisfies its acceptance criteria with recorded verification evidence; human gates require named human approval.

phases.title: Durable working documents and complete immutable revisions
phases.objective: Make saved engineering state coherent without losing legacy history or current recovery behavior.
risks: Legacy outputs were never fully snapshotted
Migration and identity rebinding can corrupt references

milestones.title: Versioned document contract and storage

tasks.title: Implement versioned document and identity contracts
implementation_steps: Add aggregate schema version, document sequence, requirements/CEM/PDM/schematic references, provenance, dirty stages and pinned versions.
Define shared stable-ID/reference validation and typed single-page symbol/pin/wire presentation independent of net connectivity.
acceptance_criteria: Round-trip fixtures preserve IDs, requirement states and enclosure-mm coordinates.
Unknown references, nonfinite coordinates and unsupported schema versions produce structured failures.

tasks.title: Add working-document and complete-output storage migration
implementation_steps: Add document storage, schema/sequence fields and revision output manifest/snapshot storage through a new additive migration.
Regenerate mappings and manifest with the existing isolated-database tool; preserve frozen migrations and seeds.
acceptance_criteria: Fresh install and upgrade from 0004_projects produce equivalent new schema.
Existing revision bytes/hashes are unchanged; generated mappings match migration head.
tasks.human_input: Authorized isolated database administration is needed for the mapping generator.

tasks.title: Implement working-document repository and versioned API
implementation_steps: Add document load and explicit Save endpoints with expected document/project versions, structured errors and persisted dirty status.
Keep requirement input drafts and display state separate; Save performs no routing, generation or revision publication.
acceptance_criteria: Two saves from one base version yield one success and one conflict retaining the losing client's edits.
Open/save round-trip does not call calculation, routing or CAD engines and does not create a revision.

milestones.completion_rule: Every task in this milestone satisfies its acceptance criteria with recorded verification evidence; human gates require named human approval.

milestones.title: Frozen output publication and historical reads

tasks.title: Snapshot every published engineering output atomically
implementation_steps: Extend publication to hash and store schematic, BOM, CAD descriptors, validation report, CEM, PDM and generator/catalog pins.
Build assets before the short publication transaction; commit all snapshot references/current pointer under the version fence.
acceptance_criteria: Injecting failure at each database write leaves the prior revision/current pointer intact.
Manifest verifies every stored representation and artifact; no computation runs inside the write transaction.

tasks.title: Remove current-generator calls from historical reads
implementation_steps: Read complete output snapshots directly and separate non-current, input-stale and incompatible-version statuses.
For legacy revisions retain original bytes, expose missing-output status and offer an explicit compatibility conversion/new revision; never invent historical output bytes.
acceptance_criteria: Changing installed schematic/BOM/CAD generators does not change hashes or bytes returned for complete historical revisions.
Tests replace generators with raising sentinels and historical reads still succeed; legacy limitations are explicit.

tasks.title: Preserve restore and legacy conversion semantics
implementation_steps: Restore by publishing a new revision linked to its source, preserving historical snapshots/assets.
Convert old overlay transforms to a reviewable draft proposal only when base IDs and versions match; require explicit user action for incompatible conversion.
acceptance_criteria: Restoration adds one revision and does not alter any original hash.
Legacy read alone creates no revision or hidden regeneration; incompatible overlays remain recoverable with an explicit explanation.

milestones.completion_rule: Every task in this milestone satisfies its acceptance criteria with recorded verification evidence; human gates require named human approval.

milestones.title: Recovery, portability and frontend adoption

tasks.title: Extend recovery checkpoints for document sequence and schema
implementation_steps: Version recovery payloads with base document/revision and independent recovery sequence; provide a compatibility reader for current checkpoints.
Retain immediate browser checkpoint, debounced server checkpoint and explicit Recover/Discard; prevent late responses clearing newer edits.
acceptance_criteria: Restart/reopen restores compatible drafts and retains incompatible edits for conflict resolution.
Simultaneous recovery writes conflict independently of project saves; autosave invokes no generation.

tasks.title: Add versioned portable package with verified managed assets
implementation_steps: Define package v2 with frozen outputs, hashes and bounded embedded or bundled asset payloads; retain safe v1 import with explicit legacy limitations.
Verify all input before atomic project creation, enforce size/path/hash limits and rebind identities for import/duplicate; required catalog pins must exist or fail explicitly.
acceptance_criteria: Export/import into an isolated compatible installation preserves output and artifact content hashes while allocating new project/revision identities.
Corrupt/missing assets, unsafe paths, unsupported versions and missing pins cause no partial project; shared assets and tombstoned history are retained.

tasks.title: Bind frontend document state to explicit save and publication states
implementation_steps: Introduce a document store/adapter and normalized API contracts while retaining workspace camera, visibility and selection state separately.
Show saved draft, dirty engineering output, historical read-only and unsupported legacy output states; keep Publish separate from Save.
acceptance_criteria: Save/reopen displays the same saved draft and never silently publishes it.
Network/conflict failures retain local data; historical views cannot accidentally submit changes against the current document.

tasks.title: Enforce immutable publication permissions and integrity checks
implementation_steps: Audit update/delete access for snapshots, versioned catalogs and shared assets; add tested guards and deployment role guidance without preventing lifecycle tombstones.
Extend read/audit checks to full output manifests and document schema compatibility.
acceptance_criteria: Supported application paths cannot overwrite published snapshots or catalog versions.
Tampered snapshots and artifacts are rejected with redacted errors; audit reports do not delete content.

tasks.title: Accept document lifecycle and historical invariance
implementation_steps: Exercise create/save/recover/publish/open-old/restore/import/duplicate/delete and changed-generator scenarios.
Verify current and historical outputs separately and document supported v1 compatibility behavior.
acceptance_criteria: All lifecycle actions preserve intended IDs, version conflicts and hash guarantees.
No complete historical read invokes generators; no Save/recovery operation publishes or reroutes.

milestones.completion_rule: Every task in this milestone satisfies its acceptance criteria with recorded verification evidence; human gates require named human approval.

phases.title: Shared operations and synchronized engineering editing
phases.objective: Route manual edits and generated proposals through one authoritative, undoable boundary.
risks: Editor tools can exceed validator capability
Large Zustand store and duplicate mutation routes can bypass operations

milestones.title: Validated atomic operation service

tasks.title: Implement operation envelope, registry and pure preview
implementation_steps: Define allowlisted operation payloads with target IDs, origin, base sequence, preconditions, parameters, affected models and proposal status.
Preview against an isolated document copy and return typed changes, required checks and dirty stages without durable mutations.
acceptance_criteria: Malformed IDs/parameters and unsupported operations fail before changing any state.
Preview preserves document/revision counts and hashes, returning reproducible differences for the same pinned inputs.

tasks.title: Persist atomic operation batches with idempotency
implementation_steps: Store operation sequence, origin, payload hash, before/after state references and idempotency key; regenerate mappings through the standard tool.
Commit a validated batch and document version in one short transaction with base-version recheck and project-scoped key uniqueness.
acceptance_criteria: A failed member rolls back the entire batch.
Retry after a lost response returns the same committed result; reusing a key with different content fails; concurrent same-base batches yield one winner.

tasks.title: Implement requirement, rating and enclosure operations
implementation_steps: Implement UpdateRequirement, ChangeComponentRating and ResizeEnclosure as versioned draft changes referencing permitted catalog choices.
Preserve requirement provenance and identify invalidated outputs; reject unsupported ratings/dimensions rather than fabricating catalog records.
acceptance_criteria: Each operation modifies only declared fields and marks required downstream outputs dirty.
Unsupported catalog substitutions and unknown requirement keys fail without losing prior document state.

tasks.title: Implement authoritative move and bounded rotation operations
implementation_steps: Apply MoveComponent in enclosure millimetres with mounting offsets and server-owned dimensions/policy.
Implement RotateComponent contract but reject nonzero unsupported rotations until P4-T10; validate known hard constraints, invalidate routes/CAD and require explicit Recompute before publication.
acceptance_criteria: Valid moves change the working PDM and preserve CEM and component IDs.
Out-of-bounds/overlap or unsupported rotation cannot become publishable; Save alone does not invoke routing.

milestones.completion_rule: Every task in this milestone satisfies its acceptance criteria with recorded verification evidence; human gates require named human approval.

milestones.title: Electrical and schematic command coverage

tasks.title: Implement reviewed DB connectivity invariants
implementation_steps: Implement terminal-reference, conductor/equipotential grouping and phase/PE boundary checks for existing DB topology.
Provide a compatibility projection for legacy nets and deterministic validation errors; preserve legacy snapshot bytes.
acceptance_criteria: Fixtures distinguish equipotential busbar junctions from individual conductors.
Cross-phase connection, dangling terminal and duplicate connection identity cases are rejected; valid existing DB fixtures remain representable.

tasks.title: Implement catalog-backed add and remove operations
implementation_steps: AddComponent allocates stable electrical/physical identities from pinned catalog data; require explicit terminal and placement intent.
RemoveComponent returns dependent connection/route/symbol consequences and applies only an explicitly confirmed cascade batch.
acceptance_criteria: Add/save/reopen retains all new identities and catalog version pins.
Removal cannot leave dangling references or silently remove unrelated connections; ambiguous cascade requires a new explicit proposal.

tasks.title: Implement connection and single-page schematic operations
implementation_steps: Implement MoveSymbol and label/junction presentation changes against the typed schematic model.
Implement ModifyElectricalConnection through CEM terminal/conductor semantics and RegenerateSchematic as an explicit proposal; preserve manual positions unless approved to replace.
acceptance_criteria: Moving a symbol never changes electrical connectivity.
Graphical wire crossings do not create connections; electrical connection changes update CEM and presentation references consistently or fail atomically.

tasks.title: Implement transaction-aware undo and redo
implementation_steps: Store sufficient before-state/inverses to undo accepted batches as new versioned operations; group a drag gesture into one command.
Recheck current preconditions on undo/redo, clear divergent redo branches and never mutate published historical revisions.
acceptance_criteria: Move, requirement, connection, add/remove and mixed batch round trips restore semantic state and dependent dirty status.
Undo from a stale base returns conflict; history survives save/reopen; one drag produces one undo entry.

milestones.completion_rule: Every task in this milestone satisfies its acceptance criteria with recorded verification evidence; human gates require named human approval.

milestones.title: Workspace tools and automatic generation adapter

tasks.title: Introduce frontend command client and shared selection
implementation_steps: Use the central HTTP client for preview/commit/undo with cancellation, normalized errors and stale-response protection.
Resolve selection by persistent engineering ID across browser, inspector, schematic and physical views; remove direct durable model writes from UI handlers.
acceptance_criteria: A rejected command retains local proposal state and displays the structured reason.
Selecting the same entity in any view highlights matching representations without duplicating engineering state.

tasks.title: Connect 2D, 3D and inspector transforms to operations
implementation_steps: Keep drag previews transient, commit one MoveComponent on release and update both views from returned PDM.
Add coordinate/snap input, explicit dirty/recompute indication and unsupported-rotation disabling; keep camera/visibility changes display-only.
acceptance_criteria: A move through 2D, 3D or inspector produces the same PDM coordinates and undo result.
Camera/visibility changes emit no engineering operation; Save persists a dirty draft without generating routes.

tasks.title: Connect schematic and catalog tools to shared commands
implementation_steps: Bind symbol moves and pin-connection editing to operations with explicit electrical effect previews.
Use catalog-backed AddComponent and dependency-aware RemoveComponent confirmation; maintain page presentation separately from CEM.
acceptance_criteria: Symbol move/undo preserves net hashes and layout after reopen.
Connecting compatible terminals updates CEM; invalid connections and unconfirmed cascading removals make no durable changes.

tasks.title: Add real-browser command and cross-view acceptance harness
implementation_steps: Add one browser automation dependency only for interactions jsdom cannot prove; provide isolated seeded backend fixtures.
Cover picking, gesture grouping, conflict handling and save/reopen using actual network contracts and representative WebGL rendering.
acceptance_criteria: Harness runs repeatably without developer database state.
Tests fail if the editor only changes a mesh overlay while saved PDM remains unchanged.

tasks.title: Adapt automatic generation to proposed operation batches
implementation_steps: Wrap the existing deterministic pipeline to produce a proposed document delta and operation batch rather than directly bypassing document authority.
Preserve user-lock metadata and stable matching identities; return a conflict proposal when generation would overwrite a manual intent.
acceptance_criteria: Manual and generated changes pass the same version and invariant checks.
Preview generation changes no revision; accepting a proposal is atomic, undoable and cannot silently discard locked placements.

tasks.title: Accept editable document vertical slice
implementation_steps: Run move/save/reopen/undo, symbol move, connection, add/remove and automatic proposal workflows.
Verify supported operations, missing validation limitations and Save/Recompute/Publish labels are documented.
acceptance_criteria: All user mutation paths use shared operations and preserve CEM/PDM authority.
Historical revisions remain unchanged; unsupported rotation is unavailable; no implicit save-time regeneration occurs.

milestones.completion_rule: Every task in this milestone satisfies its acceptance criteria with recorded verification evidence; human gates require named human approval.

phases.title: Incremental regeneration, durable execution and DB MVP acceptance
phases.objective: Compute only affected outputs, recover long-running work safely and prevent stale or unresolved results from becoming approved.
risks: Missing dependency edges cause stale results
Worker completion races can overwrite newer edits

milestones.title: Explicit stage contracts and cache correctness

tasks.title: Define executable stage registry and invalidation matrix
implementation_steps: Replace symbolic dirty-node lists with registered stage inputs, outputs, consumed field paths, prerequisites, algorithm versions and validation obligations.
Specify move, rating, connection, symbol-position, display-only, enclosure and catalog-version changes; unknown changes conservatively invalidate affected model closures.
acceptance_criteria: Registry rejects cycles and undefined stage references.
Move excludes electrical calculations; symbol movement excludes netlist; display-only changes schedule zero engineering stages.

tasks.title: Extract deterministic electrical stage adapters
implementation_steps: Wrap existing algorithms with explicit immutable inputs, pinned catalogs/rules and serializable outputs; remove implicit runtime repository access from stage execution.
Keep generated IDs stable by document identity mapping and preserve current reviewed behavior before algorithm upgrades.
acceptance_criteria: Baseline semantic output matches full-generation fixtures with deterministic identities.
Stages execute from supplied inputs without a live database transaction or hidden catalog lookup.

tasks.title: Extract physical, geometry and documentation stage adapters
implementation_steps: Expose enclosure/zoning/placement/duct routing/physical validation/CAD/BOM stages with explicit dependency ordering and lock inputs.
Retain DuctRouter and hard constraints; distinguish regenerating local geometry from rerouting the connected duct network.
acceptance_criteria: Invalid placement or disconnected/obstructed duct trunks fail before eligible CAD publication.
Stage adapters retain terminal endpoints and route-to-connection IDs and match baseline output.

tasks.title: Implement content signatures, stale detection and stage cache
implementation_steps: Persist stage results keyed by canonical consumed inputs, schema/engine/rule/catalog/model versions and policy hash.
Track document-specific input/output versions, dirty/blocked/failed/valid states and cache integrity; cached data never changes historical revisions.
acceptance_criteria: Changing a relevant rule/catalog/policy invalidates its consuming stages; unrelated fields preserve eligible cache entries.
Corrupt/mismatched cache entries are rejected and recomputed only through explicit execution.

tasks.title: Implement incremental scheduler and explicit recompute API
implementation_steps: Schedule the dirty dependency closure from the working document and expose explicit Recompute with stage execution records.
Reuse full generation as an oracle; replace propagate-change's immediate publish behavior with preview/operation/recompute boundaries.
acceptance_criteria: Incremental output equals full recomputation semantically across the change matrix.
Moved component records zero calculation/netlist executions while routing/validation/CAD refresh; Save still schedules nothing.

milestones.completion_rule: Every task in this milestone satisfies its acceptance criteria with recorded verification evidence; human gates require named human approval.

milestones.title: Durable jobs and safe worker completion

tasks.title: Add durable job records, claims and leases
implementation_steps: Persist queued/running/succeeded/failed/cancelled state, input signatures, base sequence, attempts, lease owner/expiry and artifact intent.
Implement atomic claim/heartbeat/expiry recovery with unique execution keys; remove blanket restart failure only when the durable path is integrated.
acceptance_criteria: Two workers cannot claim the same active lease.
Restart preserves queued jobs and healthy leases; only expired work is recoverable and retries have bounded attempts.

tasks.title: Implement bounded worker execution and result fencing
implementation_steps: Run stage/native workloads outside request transactions with cancellation, time/resource budgets and structured failure records.
Fence completion by job token, base document sequence and signatures; store superseded artifacts as non-current or discard their attachment safely.
acceptance_criteria: Old, cancelled or lease-lost workers cannot mark newer outputs valid or replace the current revision.
Worker crash after blob creation leaves prior revision readable; retries do not create duplicate accepted outputs.

tasks.title: Expose job progress and explicit recompute UX
implementation_steps: Add job submit/status/cancel client contracts and stage-specific progress, failure and retry UI.
Use polling initially; tie results to document sequence and protect local drafts from late completion.
acceptance_criteria: Long jobs acknowledge asynchronously and survive page reload.
Cancel/retry behavior is visible; late results from an older base never replace newer editor state.

milestones.completion_rule: Every task in this milestone satisfies its acceptance criteria with recorded verification evidence; human gates require named human approval.

milestones.title: Unified validation and protected publication

tasks.title: Implement aggregate validation with explicit applicability
implementation_steps: Aggregate requirement, electrical, physical, thermal-screen and geometry results by object, rule version, severity and applicability.
Separate geometric feasibility and prototype preview from engineering release eligibility; retain strict zero-violation physical generation.
acceptance_criteria: Any applicable required UNRESOLVED or FAIL check prevents engineering release eligibility.
Geometry PASS cannot mask unresolved bend, conductor, segregation or earth-anchor checks; NOT_APPLICABLE requires recorded rationale.

tasks.title: Harden placement validation and publication inputs
implementation_steps: Resolve dimensions, terminal data, catalog pins and saved validation policy server-side instead of trusting client-supplied PDM fields.
Require matching base sequence, valid required stage outputs and report signatures for Publish; reject bypass through legacy generate/reroute routes.
acceptance_criteria: Client attempts to shrink dimensions, erase policy or submit a foreign component cannot pass validation.
Publication fails on stale/missing outputs and preserves the previous revision; draft Save remains allowed without claiming validity.

tasks.title: Add correlated execution logging and diagnostic redaction
implementation_steps: Propagate request/document/operation/job/stage IDs through structured logs, durations and failure records.
Redact credentials, SQL parameters, internal paths and sensitive requirement text; add bounded diagnostic retention settings.
acceptance_criteria: A failed operation can be traced through job/stage IDs without exposing secrets.
Log tests inject credential-like values and confirm public errors and normal diagnostics redact them.

tasks.title: Implement approved local application trust boundary
implementation_steps: For approved local deployment, bind backend to loopback and add per-session mutation authorization with strict origin handling and appropriate Tauri handoff.

acceptance_scenarios.name: Component movement
steps: Generate reference DB and record document/revision IDs, stage hashes and invocation counts.
Select the component in 2D and verify linked 3D/inspector selection.
Drag and commit one MoveComponent; check working PDM and one undo group.
Explicitly Recompute; verify physical validation/routing/CAD refreshed and calculation/netlist invocation counts stayed zero.
Save/reopen, Publish and export; compare positions within approved tolerance.
Undo/redo and reject invalid placement without mutating history.
acceptance_scenarios.pass: PDM is authoritative, views and exports agree, and unrelated electrical computations do not execute.

acceptance_scenarios.name: Historical revision
steps: Publish and capture every snapshot/artifact hash.
Change working design and installed generator versions, then publish again.
Reopen prior complete revision with generator calls replaced by raising sentinels.
Verify identical outputs and hashes; restore to a new revision.
Open legacy incomplete revision and confirm explicit missing-output handling without fabricated historic bytes.
acceptance_scenarios.pass: No historical snapshot is rewritten and complete historical reads invoke no generation.

acceptance_scenarios.name: AI-assisted change
steps: Request a supported change and inspect structured operations and cited evidence.
Preview deterministic effects and unresolved checks without mutation.
Reject once and verify no commit.
Approve a valid fresh proposal and verify exactly one shared operation batch.
Repeat approval and attempt a stale/malicious proposal; confirm idempotent return or explicit rejection.
acceptance_scenarios.pass: AI never bypasses explicit approval, deterministic validation, operation history or version fencing.

acceptance_scenarios.name: Schematic consistency
steps: Move a symbol and confirm unchanged connectivity hashes.
Connect permitted pins and confirm CEM conductor/net changes.
Draw a crossing without junction and confirm no electrical connection.
Reject cross-phase or invalid terminal connection and undo a valid one.
For selected P8 scope, navigate cross-page references and reopen frozen drawings.
acceptance_scenarios.pass: Electrical connectivity remains grounded in CEM; presentation and page changes preserve identity.

acceptance_scenarios.name: Concurrent commands and worker recovery
steps: Submit two batches against the same sequence and require one winner.
Replay lost-response request with its idempotency key.
Crash worker after claim and recover only after lease expiry.
Finish superseded/cancelled job and verify it cannot replace current output.
Inject failure after blob creation and before revision commit.
acceptance_scenarios.pass: No lost update, duplicate accepted commit or corrupted prior revision; active healthy leases survive restart.

acceptance_scenarios.name: Hard engineering constraints and applicability
steps: Test oversize components, infeasible locks, invalid terminals, overloaded ducts and impossible bends.
Try improving optimization score with a hard violation and confirm infeasibility.
Use absent conductor/bend/earth data with geometric PASS.
Check independent numerical fixtures and versioned method/catalog provenance.
acceptance_scenarios.pass: Required FAIL/UNRESOLVED never becomes global approval; physical generation retains zero-violation policy.

acceptance_scenarios.name: Recovery, portability and backup
steps: Checkpoint edits, terminate client/server and explicitly Recover.
Attempt recovery against a changed base and retain edits with conflict resolution.
Export/import complete package to a compatible isolated installation and verify hashes/new identities.
Reject corrupt asset or missing catalog pin atomically.
Restore coherent database plus assets backup and verify all references.
acceptance_scenarios.pass: No implicit publication or silent draft loss; project packages and infrastructure backups have distinct verified scopes.

acceptance_scenarios.name: Exact CAD and export agreement
steps: Generate PDM-based exact assembly and tessellated preview through native worker.
Export STEP and reopen in independent reader path.
Compare units, instance/solid counts, orientation and bounds against approved fixtures.
Test worker crash, malformed STEP and missing kernel.
Reopen saved old revision and verify artifact immutability.
acceptance_scenarios.pass: Executed native output is valid and matches authoritative physical geometry; script text is not counted as a verified STEP export.

acceptance_scenarios.name: Performance and supported platforms
steps: Use approved hardware, datasets and warm/cold measurement definitions.
Measure drag-frame, cached-open, job-acknowledgement and large-design resource budgets.
Install/upgrade on every supported OS and exercise WebGL/Tauri/native worker.
Record exact results, failures and excluded platforms.
acceptance_scenarios.pass: Approved thresholds and platform checks pass; unmeasured goals are not reported as achieved.

scheduling_notes: Start with P0-T01. P0-T04 and P0-T07 can proceed while the test baseline is established; decisions close before P1 implementation.
P1 document API and full-revision snapshot branches can run in parallel after P1-T02. Integrate through P1-T11.
P2 frontend bindings and browser harness can proceed after the operation API contract, while backend handlers are completed. T10/T11 explicitly depend on the browser harness.
P3 electrical and physical adapters can run in parallel. Durable job storage can proceed after stage contracts while adapters are extracted.
P4 requirement/evidence preparation can start after P1 acceptance; actual method integration waits for P3 and human engineering approval.
P5 CAD worker work can overlap P4 engineering after P3; reviewed wiring documentation and final CAD acceptance explicitly depend on P4 outputs.
P6 provider/context preparation can overlap P4/P5 after their specified contracts; explanations and final acceptance depend on reviewed engineering.
P7 operational planning/security begins before all feature work ends; final release joins engineering, CAD, AI and operational acceptance.
P8 remains deferred until P7 acceptance and D08. Its schematic, feature and retrieval branches may then run in parallel; new archetype work requires separate engineering gates.
Do not run simultaneous migrations or uncontrolled edits to shared contracts. Use reviewed branches and designate one integration owner.
Dependency lists encode actual task prerequisites, including human gates. A milestone name or numerical phase order never substitutes for a missing task dependency.
